items.title: Wall Street Just Got More Bullish on GE Vernova. Consensus Now Puts the Target at $1,237.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares fell alongside the broader AI-stock selloff in mid-September, but Street price targets climbed every single quarter this year, leaving the September 18 close about 32% below the average analyst target, the widest gap in the past 15 months of data.
